metadata.goal: Find pickup-task handling patterns in the selected service region.
metadata.dataset_description: Constructed LaDe-style Shanghai case: 669 tasks, 3 courier(s), 24 courier-workday trajectories and 58683 GPS points. Routes follow the archived local OSM street network with oneway directions respected; restricted-access ways and expressways are excluded. Turn-restriction relations are not modeled. AOIs are constructed road-centered catchments, not official polygons. All times are local Shanghai time. Each task is accepted before selection and completion; the full candidate table records every pending task at each decision. speed_kmh is the mean speed of the immediately preceding GPS segment (zero during waiting/service), not an instantaneous endpoint speed. Empty last_near_destination_before_acceptance means no prior GPS observation within 250 m. Deadline-expired observations remain valid and represent late tasks; this is not an all-on-time dataset. Pickup-event GPS positions are separately constructed sensor observations with measurement errors; they are not the coordinates used to construct the continuous road trajectory.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def courier_order(df,user_df,decisions):
    rows=[]
    for (courier,day),q in df.groupby(['courier_id','service_date']):
        rows.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'tasks':len(q),
                     'concordance':float(kendalltau(q.acceptance_order,q.completion_order).statistic)})
    daily=pd.DataFrame(rows);couriers=sorted(daily.courier.unique())
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].boxplot([daily[daily.courier.eq(c)].concordance for c in couriers],tick_labels=couriers)
    for i,c in enumerate(couriers,1):
        q=daily[daily.courier.eq(c)];axes[0].scatter(i+np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(q)),q.concordance,s=30)
        axes[1].plot(q.tasks,q.concordance,'o',label=c,alpha=.8)
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Acceptance/pickup Kendall concordance',title='Courier differences persist across matched workdays',ylim=(-1,1))
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Tasks on the workday',ylabel='Ordering concordance',title='Same task volumes and AOI sets within each day');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    return {'courier_days':len(daily),'daily_task_range':[int(daily.tasks.min()),int(daily.tasks.max())],
            'mean_concordance_by_courier':daily.groupby('courier').concordance.mean().to_dict()}

evidence = courier_order(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def distance_urgency(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=decisions.merge(df[['task_id','acceptance_distance_km']],left_on='candidate_task_id',right_on='task_id',validate='many_to_one')
    d=d[d.pending_count>=4].copy();d['acceptance_location']=np.where(d.acceptance_distance_km>=1.3,'Far (≥1.3 km)','Near (<1.3 km)')
    d['window']=np.where(d.remaining_window_min<=20,'Ending within 20 min','More than 20 min')
    rates=d.groupby(['window','acceptance_location']).selected.mean().unstack()
    rates=rates.reindex(['More than 20 min','Ending within 20 min'])
    tasks=df.copy();tasks['overtaken']=0
    for _,q in tasks.groupby('trajectory_id'):
        for index,row in q.iterrows():
            tasks.loc[index,'overtaken']=int(((q.acceptance_order>row.acceptance_order)&(q.completion_order<row.completion_order)).sum())
    tasks['deferred']=tasks.overtaken>=3
    tasks['location']=np.where(tasks.acceptance_distance_km>=1.3,'Far (≥1.3 km)','Near (<1.3 km)')
    span=(pd.to_datetime(tasks.window_end,format='mixed')-pd.to_datetime(tasks.accept_time,format='mixed')).dt.total_seconds()/60
    tasks['window_span']=np.where(span<=65,'Short (≤65 min)','Long (>65 min)')
    actual=tasks.groupby(['window_span','location']).deferred.mean().unstack()
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.7),constrained_layout=True)
    actual.reindex(['Long (>65 min)','Short (≤65 min)'])[['Near (<1.3 km)','Far (≥1.3 km)']].plot.bar(ax=axes[0],rot=0,color=['#588f86','#bf874f'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Share overtaken by ≥3 later-accepted tasks',title='Actual task deferral, by acceptance distance',ylim=(0,.8));axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
    ratio=rates['Far (≥1.3 km)']/rates['Near (<1.3 km)']
    axes[1].bar(['More than 20 min left','Ending within 20 min'],ratio,color=['#708cab','#c08657'])
    axes[1].axhline(1,color='gray',ls='--',lw=1)
    for i,value in enumerate(ratio):axes[1].text(i,value+.025,f'{value:.2f}',ha='center')
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Far / near selection rate at a decision',title='Far-distance penalty weakens near the deadline',ylim=(0,1.2))
    normal=rates.loc['More than 20 min'];urgent=rates.loc['Ending within 20 min']
    return {'unit':'pending candidate at a decision with at least four tasks; lower selection rate means more deferral',
            'candidate_opportunities':len(d),'selected_rates':rates.to_dict(),
            'actual_task_deferral_rates':actual.to_dict(),'far_to_near_selection_ratio':ratio.to_dict(),
            'near_minus_far_gap_loose':float(normal['Near (<1.3 km)']-normal['Far (≥1.3 km)']),
            'near_minus_far_gap_urgent':float(urgent['Near (<1.3 km)']-urgent['Far (≥1.3 km)'])}

evidence = distance_urgency(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def aoi_day_order(df,user_df,decisions):
    rows=[];local=[]
    for (courier,day),q in df.groupby(['courier_id','service_date']):
        mix='A01–A06' if 'A04' in set(q.aoi_id) else 'A01–A03 + A07–A09'
        rows.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'aoi_set':mix,
                     'tau':float(kendalltau(q.acceptance_order,q.completion_order).statistic)})
        for aoi,r in q.groupby('aoi_id'):
            local.append({'courier':courier,'day':day,'aoi':aoi,
                'group':'Every-day AOIs' if aoi in ['A01','A02','A03'] else 'Rotating AOIs',
                'tau':float(kendalltau(r.acceptance_order,r.completion_order).statistic)})
    daily=pd.DataFrame(rows);local=pd.DataFrame(local)
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    table=daily.groupby(['courier','aoi_set']).tau.mean().unstack()
    table.plot.bar(ax=axes[0],rot=0,color=['#5c88ab','#c68d57'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Whole-day ordering concordance',title='Within-courier ordering differs with served AOI sets',ylim=(0,1));axes[0].legend(fontsize=7)
    names=['Every-day AOIs','Rotating AOIs']
    # Measure temporal variability within each courier/AOI first, rather than
    # pooling different couriers and different AOIs into one distribution.
    stability=local.groupby(['courier','aoi','group']).tau.agg(['std','count']).reset_index()
    by_courier=stability.groupby(['courier','group'])['std'].mean().unstack()[names]
    by_courier.plot.bar(ax=axes[1],rot=0,color=['#588f86','#bf874f'],width=.7)
    bar_handles,_=axes[1].get_legend_handles_labels()
    for i,courier in enumerate(by_courier.index):
        for j,name in enumerate(names):
            x=i+(-.175 if j==0 else .175)
            values=stability[(stability.courier==courier)&(stability.group==name)]['std'].to_numpy()
            axes[1].scatter(x+np.linspace(-.065,.065,len(values)),values,
                s=20,facecolors='white',edgecolors='#35495a',zorder=3)
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Courier',ylabel='Across-day SD of within-AOI concordance',
        title='Local ordering stability for each courier\nLower = more stable; each dot = one AOI',ylim=(0,.85))
    axes[1].legend(bar_handles,['Every-day AOIs (8 days each)','Rotating AOIs (4 days each)'],fontsize=7,loc='upper left')
    return {'whole_day_mean_concordance':table.to_dict(),'local_concordance_mean':local.groupby('group').tau.mean().to_dict(),
            'local_concordance_sd':local.groupby('group').tau.std().to_dict(),
            'mean_within_aoi_across_day_sd_by_courier':by_courier.to_dict(),
            'stability_unit':'Compute sample SD across days separately for each courier and AOI, then average AOI SDs within each courier/group.'}

evidence = aoi_day_order(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def event_gps_mismatch(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=df.copy();a=np.radians(d[['task_lng','task_lat']].to_numpy());b=np.radians(d[['pickup_gps_lng','pickup_gps_lat']].to_numpy())
    diff=b-a;d['mismatch_m']=6371008.8*2*np.arcsin(np.sqrt(np.sin(diff[:,1]/2)**2+np.cos(a[:,1])*np.cos(b[:,1])*np.sin(diff[:,0]/2)**2))
    d['large']=d.mismatch_m>100;table=d.groupby('aoi_id').agg(tasks=('task_id','size'),large=('large','sum'),days=('service_date','nunique'))
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    rate=table.large/table.tasks
    axes[0].bar(rate.index,rate*100,color=['#bd7055' if x>.3 else '#6c93a3' for x in rate])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Pickup-event mismatch >100 m (%)',title='A small subset of revisited AOIs contains the large errors',ylim=(0,100))
    for aoi,q in d.groupby('aoi_id'):
        axes[1].scatter(q.task_lng,q.task_lat,s=8,alpha=.35)
    q=d[d.large].head(65)
    for r in q.itertuples():axes[1].plot([r.task_lng,r.pickup_gps_lng],[r.task_lat,r.pickup_gps_lat],color='#bd7055',alpha=.4,lw=.8)
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude',title='Task location → separate pickup-event GPS observation')
    axes[1].set_aspect(1/np.cos(np.radians(d.task_lat.mean())))
    large=table[table.large>0]
    return {'large_mismatch_threshold_m':100,'large_mismatch_count':int(d.large.sum()),
            'large_mismatches_by_aoi':table.large.astype(int).to_dict(),
            'large_mismatch_rates':rate.to_dict(),'service_days_for_affected_aois':large.days.astype(int).to_dict()}

evidence = event_gps_mismatch(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()
